jobs.description:
Job Description and Responsibilities

Become part of one of the largest and fastest-growing privately held security companies in the U.S! Since 1998, Sunstates Security has built a national reputation for delivering exceptional services while fostering high-quality work environments for our team. We are dedicated to hiring, developing, and retaining a professional workforce that reflects our commitment to excellence.

We believe in strategic reinvestment in our people by offering a benefits package that exceeds industry standards, pathways for career advancement, extensive internal training, and employee recognition programs. Our team members are provided with the tools, knowledge, and hands-on management support necessary for long-term success.

Our commitment to a superior workplace culture is reflected in our most recent national accolades. Sunstates Security is proud to be recognized as a 2026 Forbes Dream Employer, an honor based on independent employee feedback and workplace excellence. Additionally, we have been named a 2026 Training MVP by Training Magazine, marking the third consecutive year we have accepted this prestigious recognition. We also continue to be celebrated for our steady growth and stability on the Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing private companies.

At the heart of everything we do are our core values of honor, integrity, and trust. If you are searching for a rewarding career with a proactive security partner that protects some of the country’s leading organizations, we invite you to explore the possibilities at Sunstates Security. Join a successful, growing team where your talent is appreciated and have opportunities to advance your professional career.

HIRING IMMEDIATELY

Sunstates Security is hosting a Hiring Event for Armed Security Officers on Wednesday, August 26, 2026, from 9:30AM -2:00PM.

Meet with Hiring Managers to explore Full-Time, Part-Time, and Flex positions on 1st, 2nd, and 3rd shifts in the Dallas, Texas area.

Various days and shifts are available with a pay range of $21.00 - $23.00/hr, with weekly pay.

{Please keep in mind that in order to attend the 8/26/2026 Hiring Event, you must have a Level III and or Level IV Security License in hand.}

Location of event:

Diversified

8435 N Stemmons Freeway

Suite 100

Dallas, Texas 75247

This is a walk-in event. Come prepared to interview with our hiring managers.



Job Requirements

Requirements:

  • Must have a Valid Texas Level III and or Level IV Security License in hand.
  • Must have reliable transportation to and from work.
  • Must have your own firearm and duty equipment.
  • Must be available to work on Sundays
  • Excellent customer service skills.
  • Security officer and/or military experience is a plus.
  • Good verbal and written communication skills.
  • Willing and able to work holidays and weekends.
  • Ability to pass criminal background and drug screen pre-hire.
  • Willing to work in various weather conditions.
  • Must regularly walk or stand for extended periods of time and distance.

A Security Officer may perform a multitude of duties as specified by the Post Orders and Standard Operating Procedures (SOP). The Security Officer will read and become extremely knowledgeable of Post Orders and SOP and will be able to act quickly and efficiently according to such directives.



Benefits

Industry-leading employee benefits that include weekly pay, 401k savings plan with a company match, affordable medical, dental & vision benefits, employee referral bonuses, paid time off, premium holiday pay, tuition reimbursement, and more – available for qualified candidates!

jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY: - Mansfield Stadium
Provide quality customer service to customers, patrons and employees. Establish working relationships with customers, vendors and employees in fulfilling assigned post orders. Take an active role in assisting customer with other duties that may not be included in this job description and are approved by the Security Manager. Event Staff must possess and maintain a professional image at all times.
RESPONSIBILITIES/DUTIES:
Essential functions may vary depending on department size, organizational structure and/or geographic location. Reasonable accommodations may be made to allow differently-abled individuals to perform the essential functions of the job. Other duties, not listed below, may also be assigned.
· The delivery of quality service and positive interaction with our customers is critical to the completion of all the tasks within this job description. The ability to greet all visitors, vendors, and employees; while continuously maintaining the standards of excellence in presentation and professionalism. Customer Service is Every Employee's Job!
· Maintain a working knowledge of all emergency policies, procedures and regulations; respond immediately to emergency alarms or calls for help, determine course of action, notify appropriate authorities and assist as needed.
· Post orders may include Ticket Taking, Ushering, Guest Services, Elevator Operator, Special Services or other.
· Be diligent and vigilant in safety awareness.
· Know and understand post orders, revisions, and daily event needs. Know your chain of command.
· These functions are not limited to these listed and may be expanded upon at any time at the request of the customer.
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:
The following are the minimum qualifications which an individual needs in order to successfully perform the duties and responsibilities of this position. Please note that the minimum qualifications may vary based upon the department size and/or geographic location.

  • High School Diploma/or equivalent (GED) and be 18 years of age or older.
  • Must be willing to submit to a background and drug screening where required; any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background investigation.
Skills/Abilities:
· Strong customer service orientation, exemplifying our Mission Statement that Customer Service is Every Employee's Job.
· Ability to facilitate progressive change, getting along with other employees, following directions and continually improving.
· Clear and effective oral and written communications skills.
PHYSICAL DEMANDS:
In general, the following physical demands are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to allow differently-abled individuals to perform the essential functions of the job.
Must be able to see, hear, speak and write clearly in order to communicate with employees and/or other customers. Pushing/pulling/carrying lifting may include up to 25 lbs (event evacuation), stair climbing. Ability to sit, twist, turn, bend as required to perform duties within the facility. Must be capable of standing for long periods of time.
This description portrays in general terms the type and level(s) of work performed and is not intended to be all-inclusive, nor the specific duties of any one incumbent. Andy Frain Services reserves the right to modify, supplement, delete or augment the duties and responsibilities specified in the position description, in the Company's sole and absolute discretion. Duties other than those expressly specified may be assigned from time to time

jobs.description:
Event Security Football Season


Overview

Company Overview:
Kick off your exciting career in Event Security with Allied Universal® Event Services, the go-to leader in crowd management and event staffing. Dive into the action at sports stadiums, concerts, festivals, and convention centers, and thrive on the energy of being where it all happens. Join a lively team that services thousands of venues each year, ensuring safety and fun for everyone. Enjoy the perks of flexible part-time work that fits your lifestyle—ideal for students, retirees, or anyone seeking a dynamic job. We offer job opportunities in event staff, security, and operations. Join our welcoming, collaborative, and innovative team, and benefit from a range of perks depending on your role and hours. At Allied Universal®, every day brings a new adventure. Ready to make your mark in the event industry? Join us and be part of the excitement!


Job Description


Allied Universal Event Services is adding to the Team
Work Football games & more!
Weekly Pay| Flexible schedules| Paid Training| Earn $21/Hr
Allied Universal® Event Services is looking to hire Event Security. This position is responsible for checking bags, enforcing access control and implementing policies and procedures for the safety of the guests and owners, while providing superior customer service for the best guest experience.
ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: Those duties necessary to meet the minimum requirements of the position. Other duties may be assigned.
  • Assist in all aspects of event day preparation and execution.
  • Allow appropriate entry into each venue, may collect and/or scan tickets, verify wristbands and badges, direct traffic coming in and out of the venue.
  • Screen guests during entry via bag searching, hand wand or metal detector, and ID verification.
  • Protect guests, staff, and venue ownership group assets by watching for security breaches at vital checkpoints.
  • Respond quickly to potential crowd control issues and provide escorts for unruly guests when ejections are warranted.
  • Demonstrate an understanding of the policies, procedures and regulations of different venues, facilities and events.
  • Provide a positive experience for guests as they arrive at your facility entrance, aisle, concourse area or other location
  • Provide guests with helpful directions and/or suggestions that will enhance their entertainment experience.
QUALIFICATIONS: To perform this job successfully, the individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or experience required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Must be 18 years of age or older.
  • Must have a high school diploma or equivalent.
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
  • As a condition of employment, candidate must successfully complete a background investigation and a post-offer/pre-employment drug/alcohol test; additional screening may be required if driving a customer or company owned vehicle.
  • Able to use good independent judgment and discretion.
  • Must be able to work overtime as needed.
  • Outstanding oral and written communication skills.

PERKS AND BENEFITS:
  • Part-time flexible scheduling under 30 hours/week that fit with your personal life goals
  • 401(k)
  • Sick Pay
  • Ongoing paid training programs and career growth opportunities
  • Employee discounts through our perks program to your favorite restaurants, entertainment venues, and much more!


Closing

Allied Universal® is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or relationship/association with a protected veteran, or any other basis or characteristic protected by law. For more information: www.aus.com
If you have difficulty using the online system and require an alternate method to apply or require an accommodation, please contact our local Human Resources department. To find an office near you, please visit: www.aus.com/offices.

jobs.title: Event Security Officers – Level II & Level III
jobs.description:
We are seeking professional, dependable, and experienced security officers to support event operations alongside event staff, venue security, local law enforcement.

Positions Available

  • Level II Non-Commissioned Security Officers
  • Level III Commissioned Security Officers

Level II Non-Commissioned Security OfficerPosition Summary

Level II Officers will provide professional, uniformed security support throughout the event. Officers will primarily be assigned to access-control, observation, guest-flow, and security-presence posts.

Responsibilities

  • Staff assigned security posts, including entrances, interior doorways, stairwells, corridors, registration areas, and other designated locations.
  • Maintain a professional and visible security presence.
  • Monitor assigned areas for unauthorized access, disturbances, suspicious activity, safety concerns, or violations of event policies.
  • Assist with orderly guest movement and crowd flow.
  • Provide basic directions and assistance to guests when appropriate.
  • Report security incidents or concerns through the established chain of command.
  • Assist event leadership, venue security, and law enforcement personnel as directed.
  • Respond appropriately to disturbances, safety concerns, or medical incidents until relieved by emergency personnel.
  • Remain at your assigned post unless properly relieved or directed otherwise.
  • Complete required incident documentation.

Important: Event personnel, not Level II officers, will have primary responsibility for validating invitations and checking guest identification.

Level II Requirements

  • Current Texas DPS Non-Commissioned Security Officer (Level II) license, or higher applicable Texas security license.
  • Must be eligible for affiliation with RKSMS through the Texas Online Private Security system prior to the event.
  • Must have completed all required Texas training and licensing requirements.
  • Level II officers will not carry firearms while performing security duties.
  • Professional appearance and conduct.
  • Strong communication and situational-awareness skills.
  • Ability to remain standing and attentive for extended periods.

Level III Commissioned Security OfficerPosition Summary

Level III Officers will provide armed security coverage at strategically designated locations throughout the event. Officers will supplement Level II personnel and support areas requiring an elevated security presence and rapid-response capability.

Responsibilities

  • Staff designated armed-security posts at higher-risk or strategically important locations.
  • Maintain a professional and highly visible armed-security presence.
  • Monitor assigned areas for threats, disturbances, unauthorized access, suspicious activity, and safety concerns.
  • Provide immediate security response when directed by event leadership.
  • Assist with de-escalation and management of security incidents within the officer's authority and training.
  • Coordinate with event leadership, venue security, and law enforcement when necessary.
  • Maintain strict firearms safety, weapons-retention, and use-of-force discipline.
  • Remain at the assigned post unless properly relieved or redirected.
  • Complete required incident documentation.

Level III Requirements

  • Current and active Texas DPS Commissioned Security Officer (Level III) license.
  • Must be eligible for affiliation prior to the event.
  • Completion of required Level III training, testing, and firearms qualification.
  • Must meet all applicable Texas DPS firearms requirements.
  • Must be qualified with the type/category of firearm authorized for use at the event.
  • Strong situational awareness, communication, and professional judgment.

jobs.title: Event Operations Manager
jobs.description:
About the Role

Andy Frain Services is on the lookout for a motivated and detail-oriented Event Operations Manager to play a key role in driving event operations across our premier Sports & Entertainment venues. You will primarily focus on Fair Park/State Fair of Texas.

In this dynamic role, you will partner directly with the Account Manager to oversee event day operations, lead the security team, and ensure exceptional safety and experiences for fans, promoters, sponsors, and vendors.

Work Schedule Note: Flexibility is essential as this position involves a dynamic, event-driven schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays based on the venue calendar.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive Salary: Commensurate with experience
  • Time Off: Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance options
  • Retirement: 401(k) retirement savings plan
  • Career Advancement: Opportunities for leadership development and professional growth within a nationally recognized industry leader

Key Responsibilities

Event Operations & Venue Leadership

  • Act as the operational lead for smaller events and manage concurrent venue dates across Dallas.
  • Oversee event-day execution, ensuring that security requirements and client standards are met.
  • Lead staff sign-in/sign-out processes and manage accurate post-event payroll and billing.
  • Serve as the primary lead in the Account Manager's absence.

Staffing, Onboarding & Development

  • Assist in the onboarding, training, scheduling, and management of event-day staff and supervisors.
  • Conduct pre-event briefings for teams of varying sizes, from small groups to over 600 personnel.
  • Monitor monthly event metrics and assess staff performance indicators.
  • Coach and mentor supervisors and staff on personnel matters in accordance with company policy.

Logistics & Equipment Management

  • Oversee the storage, distribution, maintenance, and tracking of venue equipment.
  • Prepare operational materials and documentation for event-day supervisors.
  • Submit equipment and supply requests 45 days in advance of the operational needs.

Risk Management, Safety & Client Relations

  • Identify and address potential safety risks for guests and staff.
  • Regularly meet with venue clients to ensure security, emergency preparedness, and safety compliance.
  • Ensure compliance with Federal and State OSHA, fire, and safety regulations.

About the Role
 Andy Frain Services is seeking a driven, detail-oriented Event Manager to assist in leading event operations across our premier Dallas-area Sports & Entertainment (S&E) venues with primary focus at Fair Park/State Fair of Texas.

In this role, you will work directly alongside the Account Manager to oversee event day operations, lead front-line security personnel and supervisors, and deliver exceptional safety and guest experiences for every fan, promoter, sponsor, and vendor. Work Schedule Note: This position requires flexibility to work a dynamic, event-driven schedule including evenings, weekends, and holidays based on venue calendars.

Compensation & Benefits
  • Competitive Salary: Commensurate with experience
  • Time Off: Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance options
  • Retirement: 401(k) retirement savings plan
  • Career Advancement: Leadership development and professional growth within a nationally recognized industry leader
Key Responsibilities
 Event Operations & Venue Leadership
  • Serve as the operational lead for smaller events, Event Orders (EOs), and concurrent venue dates across Dallas locations.
  • Supervise event-day execution, ensuring client security needs and account standards are fully met.
  • Lead staff sign-in/sign-out processes and coordinate accurate post-event payroll, time processing, and billing data.
  • Act as the primary lead or step in for the Account Manager in their absence.
Staffing, Onboarding & Development
  • Assist with the onboarding, training, scheduling, and distribution of event-day staff and supervisors.
  • Deliver pre-event briefings and address large groups (ranging from small teams to 600+ personnel).
  • Evaluate monthly event metrics, staff performance, and employee performance indicators (call-offs, attendance, counseling notes).
  • Coach, mentor, and guide supervisors and staff through personnel issues in accordance with company policy.
Logistics & Equipment Management
  • Manage the storage, distribution, maintenance, and tracking of venue radios, scanners, and ISS devices.
  • Prepare operational materials, shift rosters, and briefing documentation for event-day supervisors.
  • Submit formal equipment and supply requests 45 days in advance of operational needs.
Risk Management, Safety & Client Relations
  • Proactively identify and mitigate safety risks for guests, staff, and venue assets.
  • Meet regularly with venue clients to address security, emergency preparedness, and site safety protocols.
  • Ensure strict adherence to Federal and State OSHA, fire, and safety regulations.
